why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Ostium app and log in Go to the Ostium app and use Log in or Sign up. Check first that your location is not a restricted jurisdiction, since the app blocks those.
2 Step 2 : Review your standing on the points page Open the points page to see the current week, your weekly trading and LP scores, the next conversion date and the leaderboards.
3 Step 3 : Trade a market to build a trading score Open a long or short position from the trade page . Trading activity feeds your weekly trading score.
4 Step 4 : Stake LP to build a liquidity score Stake LP to build your weekly LP score, which the points page tracks separately from your trading score.
5 Step 5 : Check your scores after each weekly conversion Return to the points page after the weekly conversion to see your scores compiled into points and your place on the leaderboards.
